title: D1 subject fallback is unreachable when CISAPI is unavailable
reasoning: fetchSubjectsFromCisApi returns a hardcoded fallback list when all CISAPI requests fail, so main never sees an empty array and never calls fetchSubjectsFromD1. During dev or build-with-generated-subjects, a transient CISAPI outage can overwrite valid-subjects.ts with stale IDs whose names are just the subject codes, even if the D1 source is available.
reproduction: Make all CISAPI fetches fail while Wrangler/D1 can return subjects. The script logs the hardcoded fallback and proceeds to finish without calling fetchSubjectsFromD1.
recommendation: Try D1 before falling back to the hardcoded list, or make the CISAPI fetch return an empty result on network failure and move the hardcoded fallback after the D1 attempt.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No included test covers generate-subjects fallback ordering, CISAPI failure, or D1 fallback invocation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock fetch to fail and mock execSync to return a D1 subject row with a real name; assert the generated content uses the D1 name rather than the hardcoded code-only fallback.
